[EN] In the name of Velik, I thank you. You answered the call, and prevailed against a foe that gave even the gods themselves pause.

I can tell you that they watched this battle with great interest, and were supremely pleased at your victory.

Velik herself is waiting to reward you.
[ES] En nombre de Velik, te doy las gracias. Respondiste al llamado y venciste a un enemigo que hizo dudar incluso a los propios dioses.

Puedo decirte que observaron esta batalla con gran interés y están sumamente complacidos con tu victoria.

La misma Velik está esperando para recompensarte.
